backup.production_rule: One NEW definer function (telegram_apply_inventory_count_v1) granted to service_role only, plus one widened CHECK on telegram_pending.kind (twelve values to thirteen; nothing is narrowed, so every existing row stays valid). No table row is changed by the migration itself. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: count_rpc_is_security_definer_with_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.telegram_apply_inventory_count_v1(bigint, jsonb, text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: pending_kind_accepts_inventory_count
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%inventory_count%' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

forward_verification.name: pending_kind_still_accepts_the_twelve_existing
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%' || k || '%') from pg_constraint, unnest(array['duplicate','large_amount','photo_dup','inventory_sync','advisory_notice','advisory_scan','llm_expense','llm_notice','llm_void_notice','llm_void_txn','llm_void_txns','llm_edit_notice']) k where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

rollback.safe_until: always (drops one new function and narrows the kind CHECK back; counts already applied are real stock figures and stay, already audited as telegram_count)

feature_flags.name: telegram_expense_calls_the_count_rpc
feature_flags.required_state: The telegram-expense build carrying /count is deployed only AFTER this release is applied. Deployed earlier, the inventory_count pending row is refused by the old CHECK and /count fails closed before anything is written; the existing /stock and /inventory reads are unaffected either way.

feature_flags.name: apply_tap_needs_a_mapped_telegram_id
feature_flags.required_state: Only staff_access_profiles rows with telegram_user_id set can apply a count. One profile is mapped today (Lloyd, admin). Anyone else taps Apply and is refused with unmapped_telegram_user, which is the intended behaviour, not a failure.

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed on Alfred 2026-09-18 against the cascade-supabase-20260917T100526Z backup set: 1 migration applied, 0 failed; forward verification 6 passed, 0 failed; pgTAP supabase/tests/database/telegram_inventory_count.sql 18/18; 101 public tables before and after. One new function; the CHECK is widened, never narrowed, so every existing telegram_pending row stays valid and every existing writer keeps working.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
the rehearsal's pgTAP run is not 18/18
